intention: analytics.vehicle_metrics and vehicle_metric_watermarks are keyed on the car, not the account, so one car has one metric history whoever registered it.
request: Source ticket: MAG-69 — 6. Re-key analytics.vehicle_metrics and vehicle_metric_watermarks on tesla_id. Step 6 of MAG-63. Collapse duplicate (tesla_id, metric_date) rows, replace both unique constraints, replace idx_vehicle_metrics_latest, DROP COLUMN account_id from both tables. Drop account_id from the queries and accountID from the Reader/Recalculator ports. LatestMetricsByAccount becomes LatestMetricsForVehicles. Unit tests: excluded.

decisions.decision: Two tiers: analytics then gateway; app + gateway call-site updates folded into tier 1 as leader-owned integration
decisions.why: A tier that changes a port signature must fix its callers too, or it lands with a red build. Mirrors RM57 tier 2.

decisions.decision: MAG-71's work (3 chart queries + 3 Reader ports) is part of tier 1
decisions.why: MAG-71 was cancelled because MAG-69 covers it. Leaving it out drops account_id while three queries still filter on it.

decisions.decision: recalculateAnalytics dedupes its vehicle loop by tesla_id
decisions.why: AllRegisteredVehicles returns one row per (account, vehicle) pair with no election, so a shared car would reconcile twice with identical arguments.
It is the one port losing its WHERE account_id filter. A Ref can only be built by authorizeVehicle or vehicleref.All, so the compiler enforces what SQL used to.

decisions.decision: ConsumedByDay, OdometerDeltaByDay and BatteryLevelByDay keep teslaID int64
decisions.why: processor.go calls ConsumedByDay as a background job and cannot build a Ref. Siblings stay int64 so the set buildHistoryView calls together is uniform.

decisions.decision: buildExternalChargesPage collapses to one ownedVehicles read; ok=false (error or empty list) renders the could-not-load-vehicles error
decisions.why: Two reads of the same vehicle list per render. The empty-list behaviour change is unreachable: teslaIDFilter is non-zero only when a vehicle came from that list.

decisions.decision: The three handlers.go call sites keep vehicleref.All(teslaIDsOf(registered)); they do NOT move to ownedVehicles
decisions.why: Each already holds its own registered list, so ownedVehicles would add a second DB read per render. vehicleref-guard exempts the whole handlers.go file.
